expect_red: the row's alert mark is NOT filled and wears no box — the loudness Jeff named is gone, and so is the border that was a second mark

mutations.contract: The row's consolidated alert mark is quiet -- not filled, and not framed. It is the only alert marker on the row, so it competes with nothing and does not need to shout.
mutations.note: Jeff, 2026-09-16: "Left side menu is now impressively 'loud'... Styling for the alert text themselves can then be a bit less obnoxious/overwhelming, especially the ones in the source column that are always visible." The mutation gives the mark the filled treatment `.chip--export-unestablished` wore, which is the loudness being removed -- and 'quieter' is a computed-style claim, so a class-name check would pass straight through it. The paired sub-check ('...but it is still findable') is what stops the fix being 'delete the colour too'. RE-POINTED 2026-09-22, in review of stack_page_alert_marks_and_drawn_glyph (1c33359): the badge was `.chip--alert` -- a character in a rounded border -- and is `.rowalert`, a drawn path with no box, so the old anchor (the `.chip--alert` declaration, `color: var(--inferred); border-color: var(--inferred);` + `font-weight: 700; line-height: 1;`) is a rule that commit deletes, and the old sub-check name was reworded to cover the frame as well as the fill. The mutation now touches `color` ONLY, which keeps it narrow enough that the `DRAWN and legible` sub-check printed before the declared one stays green and the declared one is the only red -- verified by replaying `--only alert-badge-is-not-filled`.
